question: How do hyperscale AI engineering teams (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) structure multi-agent delegation without polluting context windows?
scope: Subagent isolation, specialized capability matching, structured handoff schemas, and context window partitioning
claims: Isolated subagents with dedicated system prompts reduce context window clutter and increase task success rate.
Structured JSON handoffs prevent loose text ambiguity between specialized roles.
evidence: OpenAI Swarm benchmarks demonstrate higher execution accuracy when agents hand off explicit JSON payloads.
Anthropic Claude Code subagent isolation prevents main chat thread context degradation.
observations: Orchestrator threads should remain thin, delegating heavy file reads and writes to specialized dynamic workers.
Delegation depth must be bounded (max 10 levels deep) to prevent infinite subagent recursion.
patterns: PAT-0004: Thin Orchestrator & Bounded Subagent Delegation
limitations: Subagent spawning incurs token overhead for system prompt loading.
recommendation: Incorporate thin orchestrator delegation and structured JSON handoffs into EOS Agent Selection Engine.
